title: ParseRequest
description: Request body for parsing a document via JSON. Exactly one of file_id or source_url must be provided.

file_id.description: Identifier of a previously uploaded file to parse. Mutually exclusive with source_url.

source_url.description: URL of a document to fetch and parse. Mutually exclusive with file_id.

http_proxy.description: Optional HTTP proxy to use when fetching the document from source_url.

tier.description: Parsing tier that determines the quality and speed trade-off. Fast outputs spatial text only. Cost-effective is optimized for text-heavy documents. Agentic handles images and diagrams. Agentic plus provides maximum fidelity for complex layouts.

version.description: API version to use. Use "latest" for the most recent version, or a specific version date string for production stability.

target_pages.description: Page range to parse using 1-based indexing (e.g., "1-5", "3,7,10").

agentic_options.description: Additional options for the agentic and agentic_plus tiers. Not supported by the fast tier.
